title: Academic Writing — Sports centre energy use
description: Academic Task 1 visual report and Task 2 essay. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The pie chart shows the share of electricity used for different purposes at a sports centre.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Some people think sports facilities should charge more to cover energy-saving improvements. Others think these costs should be publicly funded. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples.

Write at least 250 words.
